selection: all non-deleted ACTIVE or PENDING_RETURN orders whose authoritative activation and signed contract facts form an exact repair candidate

lock.transactionBoundary: serializable transaction; reload and hash the complete candidate set under all locks before writes

cancellation: cancel before commit; after-commit interruption is outcome-unknown and requires same-operation reconcile
idempotency: applied candidates become unchanged; replay and reconcile create no duplicate updates or audits
checksums: classification digest binds exact order/contract IDs, evidence digests, actions, dates, exceptions, unchanged rows and summary
exitCondition: retire after active source facts no longer require Stage1 repair
